name: server
description: Regna API — Fastify, Socket.IO, Prisma, Supabase Postgres. See README.md in this folder.

scriptsDoc.dev: Start the API with hot reload (default port 3001). Requires apps/server/.env.
scriptsDoc.build: Generate Prisma client and compile TypeScript to dist/.
scriptsDoc.typecheck: Generate Prisma client and run tsc without emitting files.
scriptsDoc.db:generate: Regenerate the Prisma client after schema changes (no DB connection).
scriptsDoc.db:migrate: Create and apply a new migration in dev (uses DIRECT_DATABASE_URL). Pass -- --name your_change.
scriptsDoc.db:migrate:deploy: Apply pending migrations — fresh clone, CI, or production (uses DIRECT_DATABASE_URL).
scriptsDoc.db:status: Show migration history and whether the DB matches the repo.
scriptsDoc.db:push: Push schema.prisma to the DB without a migration file — prototyping only.
scriptsDoc.db:studio: Open Prisma Studio in the browser (uses DIRECT_DATABASE_URL).
